name: rook
description: Rook band views inside Claude Code: a live pane of bands and their workers, sessions across the fleet, and the work deck

hostingSync.title: Hosting sync button
hostingSync.description: Shows h · sync hosting on the bands tab: Claude reads your Cloudflare tunnel's routes from a worker, proposes each worker's hosted sites and services, and asks before writing them. Off unless your band runs such a worker.

hostingWorker.title: Tunnel worker
hostingWorker.description: The rook worker that can list the tunnel's routes (its name as the bands tab shows it).

hostingRoutesCap.title: Routes capability
hostingRoutesCap.description: The capability on that worker that lists the tunnel's routes, e.g. cmd.routes-list.
